full_name: Two screening questions on reading ordinary newsprint and seeing a face 12 feet away, as defined in Statistics Canada's Health and Activity Limitations Survey (HALS)
domains: near vision (reading newsprint); distance vision (recognising a face at 12 feet)
scoring: visual disability present if at least one answer positive; also analysed as near only, distance only, and both positive
notes: both questions specify 'with glasses or contact lenses if normally worn'; validated against presenting VA in a 65-person subsample (p2-5); interviewed at home within CSHA
